products.title: Success Stories

card_1.title: Zalon
card_1.content: Zalon is an innovative web solution designed for the beauty and wellness sector. This platform replaces traditional paper agendas, automating appointment management and keeping your business always available.

card_2.title: Famil-E
card_2.content: Famil-E is a web platform designed to simplify family meal planning. This solution allows users to organize their weekly menus, control food costs, and receive everything directly at their home.

card_3.title: Zalon Design
card_3.content: Zalon Design is a web platform dedicated to selling Instagram templates to enhance businesses in the beauty and wellness sector. The platform offers customizable image templates that users can adapt and use on their own Instagram accounts.

card_4.title: Management and logistics system for SMEs
card_4.content: A B2B management platform dedicated to crucial areas in the operations of small and medium-sized enterprises. This platform serves as an integral back office for efficient order management, addressing critical aspects such as logistics, finance, and other key operational processes.
